text: Good morning. I am calling regarding the indemnification clause pursuant to sub-clause 4(b)(ii) of your service agreement.
I'm sorry, could you say that again? I'm not sure I follow.
Of course. The notwithstanding provision hereinafter referred to in article 7 stipulates your liability.
I'm confused. What does that mean exactly? I don't understand the legal language.
Pursuant to the aforementioned terms, pursuant to clause 6(c)(iii), you agree to indemnify and hold harmless.
Wait, what exactly does 'indemnify' mean? I think — maybe — I guess I understand but I'm really not sure.
This is the amortisation schedule subject to the notwithstanding provisions of sub-clause 8(a)(iv).
I'm still confused. Could you explain that in plain language? I don't understand any of this at all.
Do you consent to these terms?
I... I think so? I'm not sure. Yes, I suppose.
